memset.oracle: destination[i] = original low8(value) for i in range(count), in original instruction order; unknown bytes outside actual stores stay unknown
memset.zero_count: no destination dereference or fill-value observation by REP; original routine still loads arguments
memset.failure: earlier completed stores/progress remain; no return or later publication on rejection
memset.DF: explicit cdecl forward domain; no implicit support for STD

publication.callback: actual input immutable image target; numeric encodings alone never recover ownership
publication.nonempty: reject until producer-bound decode/lifetime association exists
